format: html

```{r}
install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
owid_co2_data <- read_csv("owid-co2-data.csv")
data <- owid_co2_data |> select(country, year, population, gdp, cement_co2_per_capita, co2_including_luc, co2_including_luc_growth_abs, co2_including_luc_growth_prct, co2_including_luc_per_capita, co2_including_luc_per_gdp, coal_co2_per_capita, consumption_co2_per_capita, gas_co2_per_capita, ghg_per_capita, land_use_change_co2_per_capita, methane_per_capita, nitrous_oxide_per_capita, oil_co2_per_capita, other_co2_per_capita, share_global_cumulative_co2_including_luc, share_global_cumulative_coal_co2,total_ghg)

owid_co2_data <- owid_co2_data |> mutate(gdp_per_capita = gdp/population)
owid_co2_data
```
```{r}
fig1 <- owid_co2_data |> ggplot(aes(x = ghg_per_capita, y = gdp_per_capita)) + geom_point()
fig1
```
